faqs.question: What does the Karyotyping Reflex FISH – 13, 18, 21, X, Y Amniotic Fluid test measure?
faqs.answer: This test evaluates the structure and number of chromosomes in amniotic fluid cells. It specifically looks for abnormalities in chromosomes 13, 18, 21, X, and Y.

faqs.question: Why is the Karyotyping Reflex FISH – 13, 18, 21, X, Y Amniotic Fluid test done?
faqs.answer: • To diagnose genetic disorders in the fetus • To determine the risk of chromosomal abnormalities, such as Down syndrome or Turner syndrome • To provide information for genetic counselling • To evaluate the need for further prenatal testing or medical interventions during pregnancy

faqs.question: When is the Karyotyping Reflex FISH – 13, 18, 21, X, Y Amniotic Fluid test recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test is recommended when • Abnormalities are detected during ultrasound or other prenatal screenings. • There is a family history of genetic disorders. • There are risk factors for chromosomal abnormalities. • The pregnant person is older than 35.

faqs.question: What if the results of the Karyotyping Reflex FISH – 13, 18, 21, X, Y Amniotic Fluid test are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results may indicate the presence of chromosomal abnormalities or genetic conditions. However, further confirmatory tests are required for a definitive diagnosis.

faqs.question: What to expect during the Karyotyping Reflex FISH – 13, 18, 21, X, Y Amniotic Fluid test?
faqs.answer: • You will need to provide a sample of amniotic fluid, which is collected through a procedure called amniocentesis, guided by ultrasound. • The sample is then sent to the laboratory for cell culture and chromosome analysis.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the Karyotyping Reflex FISH – 13, 18, 21, X, Y Amniotic Fluid test?
faqs.answer: Before the test: • You may need to sign a consent form as per PCPNDT guidelines. • You should submit a detailed clinical history and anomaly scan report. • Follow your doctor's instructions regarding fasting or medication restrictions prior to the procedure. • Wear comfortable clothing and plan for some rest after the test. Please reach out to your healthcare provider for any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with the Karyotyping Reflex FISH – 13, 18, 21, X, Y Amniotic Fluid test? (30 words):
faqs.answer: Other tests that may be ordered alongside this test include: • Detailed ultrasound examination • Cell-free DNA screening • Genetic counselling

faqs.question: What is the Karyotyping Reflex FISH – 13, 18, 21, X, Y Amniotic Fluid test also known as?
What is Down syndrome?
faqs.answer: Genetic disorders can result from structural or numerical abnormalities in chromosomes, affecting various aspects of development and health. Down syndrome is a genetic disorder caused by an extra copy of chromosome 21. It leads to intellectual disabilities and physical features like a flat face and upward-slanting eyes.
